Broccoli Slaw
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 6:38am

Ingredients




1 pound prepackaged broccoli slaw
cup golden raisins
1 bot cole slaw dressing ( I use homemade tofu may
1 granny smith apple shredded

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients and chill to blend flavors. Yummy! 2 NOTES : Here is a cool and quicky yummy summertime salad! (Bet you can't say that 5 times FAST! ;o) A friend of mine,loves serving this with leftover diced chicken breast.
